name: Continue
summary: The first part of the request was received; the client should keep sending the body or ignore this interim response.

name: Switching Protocols
summary: The server agrees to switch to the protocol named in the Upgrade header, for example WebSocket.

name: Early Hints
summary: Interim response with Link headers so the client can start preloading resources before the final response.

name: OK
summary: The request succeeded; what the body contains depends on the method.

name: Created
summary: A new resource was created; the Location header should identify it.

name: Accepted
summary: The request was accepted for processing that has not finished; the outcome is not guaranteed.

name: Non-Authoritative Information
summary: A transforming proxy modified the 200 response of the origin server.

name: No Content
summary: The request succeeded and there is no body to send; typical for DELETE and for updates that return nothing.

name: Reset Content
summary: The request succeeded and the client should reset the document view that sent it.

name: Partial Content
summary: Only the requested byte range is returned, in answer to a Range request.

name: Multi-Status
summary: The body carries several independent status codes, one per sub-operation (WebDAV).

name: Multiple Choices
summary: Several representations are available and the client or user has to pick one.

name: Moved Permanently
summary: The resource has a new permanent URI; clients should update their links.

name: Found
summary: Temporary redirect; clients may change a POST into a GET when following it.

name: See Other
summary: The result is at another URI and must be fetched with GET; often used after a POST.

name: Not Modified
summary: A conditional GET or HEAD found the cached copy still valid, so no body is sent.

name: Temporary Redirect
summary: Temporary redirect that keeps the method and the body of the request.

name: Permanent Redirect
summary: Permanent redirect that keeps the method and the body of the request.

name: Bad Request
summary: The server cannot process the request because of a client error such as malformed syntax.

name: Unauthorized
summary: Credentials are missing or invalid; the response carries a WWW-Authenticate header.

name: Payment Required
summary: Reserved for future use; some APIs use it to signal billing limits.

name: Forbidden
summary: The server understood the request but refuses to authorize it; authenticating again will not help.

name: Not Found
summary: The target resource does not exist, or the server does not want to reveal that it does.

name: Method Not Allowed
summary: The method is known but not supported for this resource; the Allow header lists the valid ones.

name: Not Acceptable
summary: No representation matches the Accept headers of the request.

name: Proxy Authentication Required
summary: The client must authenticate with the proxy first.

name: Request Timeout
summary: The server gave up waiting for the request; the client may repeat it.

name: Conflict
summary: The request conflicts with the current state of the resource, for example a duplicate or an edit collision.

name: Gone
summary: The resource existed once and was removed on purpose; no forwarding address is known.

name: Length Required
summary: The server refuses the request without a Content-Length header.

name: Precondition Failed
summary: A condition in If-Match, If-Unmodified-Since or a similar header evaluated to false.

name: Content Too Large
summary: The request body is larger than the server is willing to process (formerly Payload Too Large).

name: URI Too Long
summary: The target URI is longer than the server is willing to interpret.

name: Unsupported Media Type
summary: The content type or content encoding of the request is not supported for this resource.

name: Range Not Satisfiable
summary: None of the ranges in the Range header overlap the current size of the resource.

name: Expectation Failed
summary: The server cannot meet the expectation given in the Expect header.

name: Misdirected Request
summary: The request reached a server that cannot produce a response for that URI.

name: Unprocessable Content
summary: The syntax is right but the content fails semantic validation (formerly Unprocessable Entity).

name: Locked
summary: The resource is locked (WebDAV).

name: Too Early
summary: The server will not risk processing a request that might be replayed.

name: Upgrade Required
summary: The client must switch to another protocol; the Upgrade header names it.

name: Precondition Required
summary: The server requires the request to be conditional, which prevents lost updates.

name: Too Many Requests
summary: The client sent too many requests in a given time; Retry-After may say when to try again.

name: Request Header Fields Too Large
summary: The headers are too large, either one of them or all together.

name: Unavailable For Legal Reasons
summary: The resource is blocked because of a legal demand.

name: Internal Server Error
summary: The server hit an unexpected condition and could not fulfil the request.

name: Not Implemented
summary: The server does not support the functionality needed, for example an unknown method.

name: Bad Gateway
summary: A gateway or proxy received an invalid response from the upstream server.

name: Service Unavailable
summary: The server is temporarily unable to handle the request because of overload or maintenance; Retry-After may be sent.

name: Gateway Timeout
summary: A gateway or proxy did not get a timely response from the upstream server.

name: HTTP Version Not Supported
summary: The server does not support the HTTP version used in the request.

name: Insufficient Storage
summary: The server cannot store the representation needed to complete the request (WebDAV).

name: Network Authentication Required
summary: The client must authenticate to gain network access, as in a captive portal.
